implementation: Implemented an L5 connector-neutral paper adapter with immutable versioned capability manifests, outbound canonical Order mapping, inbound external Fill normalization, exact local/external order and fill-set reconciliation, deterministic imported Fill identities, connector health outcomes, and fail-closed unsupported behavior.

tqsim_manifest.runtime_version_policy: must be supplied explicitly by deployment; never guessed
documented_limitations: limit order requires an opposing price and does not fill without an opponent
market order auto-cancels without an opponent
simulated fills are all-or-none and do not support partial fills
TqSim evidence is L5 Paper and cannot be labeled L3/L4 high fidelity

tests.v5_regression: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run pytest tests/contract/test_v5_001_tick_replay.py tests/contract/test_v5_002_order_book.py tests/contract/test_v5_003_paper_adapter.py tests/contract/test_v5_004_algorithms.py tests/contract/test_v5_005_exposure.py tests/contract/test_v5_006_calibration.py -q
tests.full_gate_result: lock, format, ruff, mypy, secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 11 property, 869 contract, and health passed

acceptance_mapping.outbound_order: PaperOrderIntent binds local typed order ID, external client order ID, instrument, direction, quantity, prices, idempotency key, and connector manifest digest without claiming venue acceptance.
acceptance_mapping.inbound_fills: External fills are validated for exact order/instrument/direction, quantity closure and unique IDs before deterministic conversion to canonical immutable Fill facts.
acceptance_mapping.bidirectional_reconciliation: Local Order plus complete local Fill set are compared against external Order plus complete external Fill set for mapping, quantity, lifecycle status, contract identity and cross-system totals.
acceptance_mapping.fail_closed: UNKNOWN state, UNKNOWN/DEGRADED connector health, missing order quantity, mismatches, duplicate fills, and unsupported TqSim partial-fill claims all set can_assume_success=false.
acceptance_mapping.model_limitations: Every adapter has a content-addressed L5 manifest; TqSim official limitations and explicit runtime version are retained.

limitations: No real-money or broker routing is present; this adapter is research/simulation only.
Live TqSdk connectivity requires deployment credentials and runtime package/version verification; local Acceptance covers the connector boundary, translations, and reconciliation semantics.
model_output_not_authoritative: Completion is determined by typed contracts, fail-closed tests, full-set reconciliation checks, official capability evidence, and repository gates.
